note: Series master — admin-owned configuration, seeded here because the Design App has no Admin UI. A room picks exactly one series (kitchen rooms.series_id); the generator, cabinet library and pricing must only offer SKUs whose code matches that series' catalog. Adding a series is a data change only — code must never enumerate series; the picker lists them in FILE ORDER, two per row (Modern row first, then Classic; each row ascending in price). startingRatePerSqft is the series rate (₹/sqft), revised 2026-10-04 (series renamed Elite→PG2, Signature→PG1; the ids keep the old words because saved rooms store them): the Quote prices each cabinet as this rate × its workbook Carcass Net Sqft (the workbook itself carries no rates). finishGroups fixes the finish group per series; finishLabel is the DESIGNER-FACING name for it (PG codes and carcass material names never appear in the UI). carcass comes with the series and is never a designer choice. handleTypes lists the handle families available in that series (the catalog's _CJ/_EH model variants); a series with one entry skips the handle step entirely. finishStyle (Modern | Classic) locks a series to that finish style. group (PG1 | PG2) is the price group a series belongs to; every cabinet in a room is priced at the rate of the room's one series. eleanorLight / visiblePanel say whether the series offers the Eleanor light and the visible panel; the picker card shows both.
